exercises.title: 7. Pratique: Complex noun phrases and strategic discourse

items.prompt: The quiet but extraordinary ___ of complacency has reshaped talent strategy.
The organisation's ___ to earn sustained attention in a distracted market is the central challenge.
items.hintAfterError: Precisamos do substantivo derivado do adjetivo (termina em -ity).

items.prompt: The re-examination of long-held ___ about shared physical space has only just begun.
The hard-to-measure cost of reduced informal mentoring ___ more attention.
items.hintAfterError: O núcleo do sujeito é 'cost' (singular), não 'mentoring'.

items.prompt: Czarnikow's competitive advantage increasingly depends on its ability to ___, not assume, commitment.
